newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent holds London levels, further fall seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent holds London levels, further fall seen.

text.p: April Brent crude futures in Asia were holding overnight London levels in late afternoon trading on Tuesday, but brokers said London might look to test further lows yet.
April Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $19.13 per barrel, up one cent from London, with 121 lots registered.
London April Brent dropped 67 cents to $19.12 on Monday -- closing just above the intraday low of $19.10 which was a seven month low on a front-month basis.
NYMEX crude futures were also steady. The April contract on ACCESS last traded at $20.75, up four cents from New York.
Brokers said they expected April Brent to push below $19.00 before finding significant support in the wake of the slide late last week and on Monday.
NYMEX April crude was likely to target $20.25 before finding support, one broker said.
